Gold.note: Central bank buying and rate cut expectations offset recent historical pullback.

Silver.note: Strong photovoltaic demand and monetary premium support recovery from oversold levels.

Copper.note: Tight mine supply and electrification trends offset soft near-term Chinese property demand.

Uranium.note: Structural supply deficit and global nuclear renaissance support sustained price strength.

Lithium.note: Near-term oversupply and EV battery demand growth deceleration weigh on pricing.

Nickel.note: Continued Indonesian supply growth outpaces stainless steel and battery demand.

Zinc.note: Smelter treatment charges at historic lows indicate tight concentrate supply.

Iron Ore.note: Weak Chinese property sector and compressed steel margins cap upside.

Coal.note: Elevated current prices offset by long-term thermal demand destruction and ESG headwinds.

Rare Earths.note: Geopolitical supply risks and EV motor demand provide a floor despite weak spot data.

Manganese.note: Balanced market with steady steelmaking demand and minor supply disruptions.

PGM.note: Platinum substitution in auto catalysts and hydrogen potential offset weak palladium demand.

Potash.note: Normalizing global inventories and steady agricultural demand balance the market.

Aluminum.note: Tight alumina supply and strong green energy demand offset sluggish primary metal growth.

Diversified.note: Broad commodity exposure provides a hedge against idiosyncratic risks in a mixed macro environment.
